message.content: Netflix Inc, a member of the Communication Services sector, closed at 76.77 with a session high of 77.73 and a low of 75.92 on a volume of 33.87 million shares. Recent earnings reactions show mixed results with the latest report on 2026-07-17 showing an actual of 0.8 against an estimate of 0.79, while previous quarters included misses such as a -15.71 per cent surprise in October 2025 and a -6.82 per cent surprise in April 2026.
